_comment: Versions that exist as a vX.Y.Z tag but are deliberately absent from PyPI,
each with the reason. scripts/check_published_versions.py fails on any tag
missing from PyPI that is NOT listed here, and on any entry here that IS on
PyPI (a stale exemption hides the next real gap).
Adding an entry is a decision to leave a published GitHub release
unavailable on PyPI. Prefer fixing the release over adding an entry.
_pre_automation: Everything below 0.14.0 predates automated publishing. The first file in
while 0.13.4 was tagged 2026-06-02: releases up to then were uploaded by
hand, so for those gaps there is no workflow run to inspect. Each entry
records what the tag and PyPI dates establish (confirmed); why a given
manual upload was skipped is inference from that timing, not a recovered
log. They are recorded rather than excluded by a cutoff so the check keeps
0.0.1: Tagged 2026-03-01, before contextweaver existed on PyPI: the earliest release PyPI serves is 0.1.0, tagged 2026-03-02. Pre-publication tag, never intended for PyPI.
0.0.4: Tagged 2026-03-02, hours before 0.1.0 became the first version on PyPI. Pre-publication, as 0.0.1.
0.9.0: Tagged 2026-05-20 in the hand-published era, superseded by the 0.9.1 tag the next day and by 0.10.0 (on PyPI) on 2026-05-22. Neither 0.9 tag was uploaded; the line recovered forward at 0.10.0.
0.9.1: Tagged 2026-05-21, superseded by 0.10.0 (on PyPI) the next day. As 0.9.0.
0.11.0: Tagged 2026-05-27 and superseded the next day by 0.11.1, which is on PyPI. The patch was uploaded, this tag was not.
0.13.0: One of four 0.13.x tags cut on 2026-06-02; 0.13.4, tagged the same day, is the one on PyPI. Four tags in a single day is a hand-run upload being retried until it worked.
0.17.0: Release published 2026-07-23, but publish.yml never ran for it: at that tag the workflow had only an `on: release` trigger and no workflow_dispatch, so there is no run to re-drive and the tag cannot be re-published without moving it.
0.18.0: publish.yml run 23 (2026-08-09) failed its own release-integrity gate: 'Missing release benchmark snapshot: benchmarks/results/history/0.18.0.json'. The tag is immutable and the file is not in its tree. release-readiness.yml exists because of this.
0.18.1: publish.yml run 26 (2026-08-11) failed the gating suite in the verify job: api-manifest drift (the environment-dependent generator bug fixed later by #869) plus a missing rank-bm25 backend in that job. Both are fixed on main; neither is fixed in the immutable v0.18.1 tree.
